integrity.mathematical_basis: Explicit real-interval derivative positivity via exact rational finite polynomial and analytical Taylor-tail enclosure.

scientific_limitations: The exact individual-order moment formula and fourth-order disk defect already appear in prior literature and are not claimed as novel.

title: Strict isotropic-constant ordering of regular Reuleaux odd-gons
